recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If future changes to this extension are needed, make them in HL7/sdc rather than FHIR core; no follow-up is needed for FHIR-17774's requested Questionnaire context based on the current SDC FSH.
issue_request: FHIR-17774 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Questionnaire issue asking that questionnaire-contextItem also allow context on Questionnaire, for cases where the whole Questionnaire has a single resource as its context.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites Git#1ac352d. That short hash is HL7/sdc commit 1ac352da09bb3f8e6d5056019e695196985d15b7, not a current FHIR-core commit; it added Questionnaire to the itemContext context list and updated the definition. A same-day HL7/sdc commit a3ecacb063a76ecf3f5a551105e417041867d38c added itemContext to SDC populate and extract profiles.
additional_context: FHIR-19527 moved questionnaire-itemContext and related Questionnaire extensions from FHIR core to the SDC IG. Current FHIR core source and the FHIR Extension Pack have no itemContext/itemcontext extension source. Current HL7/sdc source uses successor definitions sdc-questionnaire-itemPopulationContext and legacy sdc-questionnaire-itemExtractionContext, both of which declare Questionnaire and Questionnaire.item contexts.
reconciliation: No FHIR-core source was changed. The reconciliation records that the requested change has already been applied in the external SDC source line and that there is no in-scope authoritative core artifact to edit.
